question: Which of the following is an example of double displacement reaction?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Na2SO4(aq) + BaCl2(aq) longrightarrow BaSO4(s) + 2NaCl(s)**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The reaction Na2SO4 (aq) + BaCl2 → BaSO4 (s) + 2 NaCl (aq) + 2 NaCl (aq) is the example of Double displacement reaction.

 
 
• The reaction between Na2SO4 + BaCl2 is an endothermic reaction.
 
• When barium chloride (BaCl2) and sodium sulfate (Na2SO4), which leads to the formation of sodium chloride and barium sulphate.
 
• As a result of the above-given reaction, a white colour precipitate is formed due to the formation of barium sulphate.
